request: How to change the inlet temperature of a flow stream?
guidance: Double-click on the inlet stream (process stream) on the flowsheet to open its properties
located the opened Stream Properties Viewer window
In the Project Viewer window, click the 'Properties' tab make sure it is on foreground
Find the 'Temperature' field in the table
Click on the Row of 'Temperature' and column of 'Total' to enter the new temperature value
If user did not specify units, prompt user to decide on temperature units (°F or °C)
Click the cell next to 'Temperature' to set temperature units (°F or °C) from the dropdown if user specified
Press Enter or click outside the cell to confirm the change
Close the stream properties viewr window
The stream will turn brown indicating it is ready for execution
